notes.title: Update #7025 - Improvements for Stalcraft X
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! This is the first small update in this year.

We fixed a bug when the crosshair in Hooks mode became a texture from the Stalcraft game. This fix affects all OpenGL games, of course.
Also we found & fixed interesting bug which could drop some fps on some PCs in Stalcraft X.
Fixed bug on multi-monitor systems: wrong HudSight window position on start-up in the case of disappearing of previously active monitor.

A new regular update is coming soon with new features related to crosshairs construction.

notes.title: Update #7012 - Compatibility with EAC games and other improvements
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We have some great news for you!

In this update, the most exciting thing is that HudSight 2 in draw mode «Hooks» is once again compatible with games that use Easy Anti-Cheat. We have developed a special workaround that allows us to inject our DLL signed with an old digital certificate that is whitelisted by EAC.

The issue has now been resolved for games such as Rust, Fortnite, Apex Legends, Throne and Liberty, Hunt: Showdown 1896, The First Descendant, War Thunder, THE FINALS, ELDEN RING, Dead by Daylight, Squad, Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, Crossout, Black Desert, VRChat, and many others that use EAC. Read the details at the end of this news.

We would like to remind you that we updated our digital code certificate in February, which needs to be whitelisted by Easy Anti-Cheat for our program to work correctly with their games. Unfortunately, after their transition to EPIC, we lost all contact with their staff and cannot reach anyone from them :(

Is this dangerous? Not at all. HudSight operates like an old whitelisted version when interacting with EAC-based games, and it does not contain any bad or unsafe «hacks».

Other changes in this release:
 Fixed a bug where the selected crosshair was not marked as a favorite.
 Improved compatibility for authentication and activation in Steam.
Helpful information!

We have created a file named games.txt containing a list of 75 popular games that use EAC anti-cheat. If your crosshair does not work in «Hooks» mode when launching a game with EAC and the game is not in the list, you can add the process manually. To do this, navigate to the root folder of HudSight at Steam\steamapps\common\HudSight\hooks\oldsign\ and open the file games.txt. Add the required process to the end of the file and report new games to support so they can be included in future updates. Please note that the program update will overwrite the file.

notes.title: Release #6990 notes
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Changes in this build:

Added a new crosshair draw mode - Simple mode. You can read more about this mode on our web site.
Selection of the crosshair draw mode is moved to a separate tab in the main software window, where you can choose one of 4 modes: Simple Overlay mode, Real Overlay mode, Game Bar and Hooks modes. Each mode has its own pros and we're sure that you'll find your ideal option.
Added multi-display support in Simple and Real modes. You need to choose the active display in their settings where your crosshair will be displayed. 
Added several software interface localizations: Bulgarian, Czech, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish.

notes.title: HudSight Version 2 (major update) #6900
notes.notes:
Hello, everybody!

We've just released a new major update for HudSight - version 2.
This version has new interface, it may seem a bit complicated but don't be afraid :)

What are the changes, in two words:

Custom profile for every crosshair (with one default profile for all other crosshairs)
Added support for Steam workshop (as another way for custom crosshairs)
Added image generator for fast creating of crosshairs
Better image editor usability (undo/redo is added)
Added support for «Xbox Game Bar» widget as alternative for «Hooks».
Read more here https://hudsight.com/support/xbox-gamebar-crosshair-overlay

Some of new features are not included in this release and they'll be enabled in the next updates.
Next updates will also have another alternative to «Hooks» and Game Bar widget. We know some gamers do not like xbox bar, so you will have similar feature but without «Xbox» letters :)
